newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Elpo seeks May parallel floor entry - PAP.
newsitem.headline: Polish Elpo seeks May parallel floor entry - PAP.

text.p: Polish garment maker Elpo SA, due on February 20 to become the first firm to enter the Warsaw bourse's third market for very small stocks, wants to enter the second, so-called parallel floor in May, its president said.

PAP news agency on Monday reported Kazimierz Brzezinski as telling a news conference that all criteria for a parallel market entry would be fulfilled when Elpo published last year's financial results after a late March shareholders meeting. @

Poland's main market lists stocks of larger capitalisation and a longer history of audited financial reports, while the parallel market accepts smaller companies with publicly disclosed, audited, financial report for one fiscal year.
The third, so-called free market in which Elpo starts trading on Thursday has the least demanding listing requirements.
Currently 71 issues trade on the Warsaw bourse's main market and 17 on the parallel floor.
